_comment: Two sections. 'aliases' maps a lab's parameter-name spelling to the exact contaminant name as it appears on the EPA page, so the scraped row can be matched. 'supplemental' is for parameters that are NOT literally a row in either EPA table (no federal MCL exists, or the number only appears in a footnote/rule summary rather than the table cell) - these must be reviewed by hand if EPA policy changes, since they can't be auto-scraped.

supplemental._comment: type: quantitativeField | qualitativeField | null (null = no numeric limit, just used to fill unit if blank). These values were hand-verified against EPA guidance; re-check them periodically, they cannot be scraped from the two table pages.

total coliform.note: Table gives 5.0% positive-samples-per-month rule (footnote 4); labs report presence/absence per sample.

e.coli.note: Not a separate table row; grouped under Total Coliforms rule.

legionella.note: Table row is Treatment Technique only, no numeric MCL cell.

turbidity.note: 1 NTU max comes from Surface Water Treatment Rule footnote, not the MCL table cell (which is TT).

heterotrophic plate count.note: 500 CFU/mL comes from Surface Water Treatment Rule footnote, table cell is TT only.

chloroform.note: This is the individual MCLG for chloroform listed in the TTHM footnote, not a standalone MCL row.

sodium.note: No federal MCL/SMCL for sodium; 20 mg/L is a commonly used health-advisory level for sodium-restricted diets, not an EPA table value.

ammonia.note: No federal MCL for ammonia; not scrapable from either table.

microcystin.note: EPA health advisory, not an enforceable NPDWR/SMCL table entry.

total alkalinity.note: No federal limit; unregulated water-chemistry parameter, kept only to fill unit.

radon.note: Proposed but never finalized as an enforceable NPDWR; no current federal MCL.
